description:

Discover this Four Bedroom, Two Bath Ranch Townhome in Columbus, OH. The single-level layout includes four bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a finished basement for additional living or storage space. The bedrooms found on the main level are carpeted, while the ones in the basement feature vinyl flooring. The kitchen comes equipped with a stove, refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher and garbage disposal. Washer/dryer hookups are provided for convenience. Step outside to a private back deck and a fenced-in yard. Central air conditioning keeps the home comfortable year-round.

To schedule a showing, please visit our website www.RoostRentals.

Every applicant will go through our standard screening process, which includes a background check, credit review, income verification, and verification of rental history with the current landlord. Please make sure to submit all required documents and information so your application can be processed without delay.

All individuals over the age of 18 that will be living on the property need to submit their own application for background, income, and rental verification purposes. Applicants are required to have a monthly income of at least 3x the rent amount. Please provide 3 months of paystubs to ensure that your income can be fully verified. We do not accept bank statements as proof of income. 

Tenant is responsible for gas and electric.

Pets are welcome! *There is a $300 non-refundable pet deposit and a $35 monthly pet fee per pet.

Upon approval, the security deposit will reserve the property exclusively for the approved applicant until the scheduled move-in date. If the applicant is approved for the move-in and does not take possession by the scheduled move-in date, the security deposit will be forfeited.

The application fee is $65. If approved, there is a $99 admin fee due at lease signing.

Please be aware of scammers online. This property is NOT on craigslist or Facebook. This home is managed and advertised by Roost Real Estate.
